headline: Dollar rates surge: Open market price hits 128.50 BDT
summary: US Dollar prices have risen in both open markets and banking channels, increasing import costs and affecting other foreign currencies.
details: The US Dollar has seen a sudden price hike in Bangladesh's open market, reaching 128.50 BDT per dollar. Banking channels have also experienced a rise, with banks selling cash dollars at 126.50 BDT.
caption:
The US Dollar has surged to 128.50 BDT in the open market, driving up import costs across the country.

The US Dollar has seen a sudden price hike in Bangladesh's open market, reaching 128.50 BDT per dollar. Banking channels have also experienced a rise, with banks selling cash dollars at 126.50 BDT.

headline_marked: J&K CM [[Omar Abdullah marries journalist Nidhi Razdan]]
headline: J&K CM Omar Abdullah marries journalist Nidhi Razdan
summary: The 56-year-old Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir announced the union in a private ceremony in Srinagar.
details: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has married journalist Nidhi Razdan. The couple announced their marriage on social media on Saturday.
The 56-year-old Chief Minister shared a photo of the couple on X, captioning it 'Yesterday a new journey began.' The 49-year-old journalist confirmed the news by replying, 'Its done bro.'
The wedding was a small, private family gathering in Srinagar, attended by Farooq Abdullah, Moli Abdullah, and other close relatives.
Nidhi Razdan's parents, veteran journalist M.K. Razdan and Sarla Razdan, were also present at the ceremony.
Omar Abdullah was previously married to Payal Abdullah. The couple had been separated since 2009 and had a long legal battle over their divorce.
Their divorce was officially granted by the Supreme Court of India in July after they reached a mutual agreement.
Omar and Payal, who married in 1994, have two sons, Zahir and Jamir.
caption:
A new journey begins for J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and journalist Nidhi Razdan.

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has married journalist Nidhi Razdan. The couple announced their marriage on social media on Saturday.

The 56-year-old Chief Minister shared a photo of the couple on X, captioning it 'Yesterday a new journey began.' The 49-year-old journalist confirmed the news by replying, 'Its done bro.'

The wedding was a small, private family gathering in Srinagar, attended by Farooq Abdullah, Moli Abdullah, and other close relatives.

Nidhi Razdan's parents, veteran journalist M.K. Razdan and Sarla Razdan, were also present at the ceremony.

Omar Abdullah was previously married to Payal Abdullah. The couple had been separated since 2009 and had a long legal battle over their divorce.

Their divorce was officially granted by the Supreme Court of India in July after they reached a mutual agreement.

Omar and Payal, who married in 1994, have two sons, Zahir and Jamir.
